cases.scenario: writing desk twelve surfaces preserve themes mobile panels and accessible actions

expectations.statement: Twelve isolated login, list, creation, editor, preview and history surfaces preserve theme tokens, fit 320–1440px and 480px short viewports, switch mobile sections and Markdown/preview by keyboard, with zero axe violations.
No horizontal overflow, inaccessible hidden settings, duplicate visible editor/preview, browser page errors or warnings.

cases.scenario: 本地 production-build preview 首页满足四项桌面 Lighthouse 发布阈值。

expectations.statement: 本地 production-build preview 的 Performance、Accessibility、Best Practices 与 SEO 四项 Lighthouse 分数均达到 90。
任一受控 Lighthouse 类别低于 90 时不得通过 Web 质量门禁。

test_refs.name: local production-build preview homepage meets all Lighthouse 90 thresholds

cases.scenario: writing desk saves retries blocks conflicts and reveals hidden invalid fields

expectations.statement: Real three-type mobile creation reveals missing Slug, saves and publishes; working updates remain private; failed saves retain input, retry and publish exact latest text; real concurrent updates produce conflicts; new drafts and dirty edits warn before loss.
Failed or conflicting saves cannot navigate away or issue publish; unpublished working content never appears publicly; publish failure must not navigate or discard text.

test_refs.name: writing desk saves retries blocks conflicts and reveals hidden invalid fields

cases.scenario: writing desk media and incomplete references remain explicit through publication

expectations.statement: New article uploads a real isolated image; Alt validation returns to Markdown; incomplete references declare their unsaved status and focus settings; completing a project reference persists and publishes its real link and image.
Missing Alt cannot publish; incomplete references cannot be silently lost on navigation or described as saved.

test_refs.name: writing desk media and incomplete references remain explicit through publication

cases.scenario: Writing-desk dependencies and authentication preserve explicit load and credential failures.

expectations.statement: Isolated upstream failures remain non-success for editors and new-page dependencies; login exposes pending and recoverable errors; safe return path survives 401.
Upstream failures cannot become blank successful editors; unsafe return targets cannot redirect out of the admin boundary.

test_refs.name: admin editors do not render load failures as empty success
session 500 remains an error and 401 preserves the requested admin route
login exposes its pending state before restoring an actionable error state
login classifies failures and accepts only safe return targets

cases.scenario: M02.editing: autosave scenarios at the existing module boundary.

expectations.statement: debounces edits and saves only the latest snapshot; reports optimistic locking conflicts; treats published-slug 409 as a save error instead of a version conflict; waits for an in-flight save and drains the latest queued snapshot; prompts before unload only while a snapshot is dirty

cases.scenario: writing desk previews real revisions compares and rolls back with visible failures

expectations.statement: Preview declares its working-copy boundary and renders one H1; history reads real content and diff; accessible confirmation restores focus; rollback creates a new monotonic revision whose content is public.
Rollback must not rewrite a past revision; failed snapshot retrieval must not retain another snapshot as its successful result.

test_refs.name: writing desk previews real revisions compares and rolls back with visible failures

cases.scenario: 管理员比较两次发布并以新 revision 回滚到历史内容。

expectations.statement: 修订列表按新到旧返回，差异包含两版正文，回滚后公开正文等于目标历史内容。
回滚不得覆写既有 revision；必须创建单调递增且带 rollback 来源和目标标识的新 revision。
